definitions: To extend one's body or a part of it to its full length.
To make something last longer than usual or necessary.
To offer or extend something, such as a hand or help.
To lie down and extend one's body fully.
examples: She likes to stretch out on the couch after work.
He stretched out his hand to help her up.
They tried to stretch out their supplies for another week.
The cat stretched out in a patch of sunlight.
